groups.title: CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form v1.0 (OMB 1670-0052) — Section III attestations

controls.title: CISA SSDAF scope 3 — whether the producer delivers continuous changes to the software code (SaaS, CI/CD) must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CISA SSDAF scope 3 — whether the producer delivers continuous changes to the software code (SaaS, CI/CD) must be declared true or false

controls.title: CISA SSDAF scope 1 — whether the software was developed after September 14, 2022 must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CISA SSDAF scope 1 — whether the software was developed after September 14, 2022 must be declared true or false

controls.title: CISA SSDAF scope 2 — whether software developed before September 14, 2022 was modified by a major version change after that date must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CISA SSDAF scope 2 — whether software developed before September 14, 2022 was modified by a major version change after that date must be declared true or false

controls.title: CISA SSDAF exclusion 1 — whether the software was developed by a Federal agency must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CISA SSDAF exclusion 1 — whether the software was developed by a Federal agency must be declared true or false

controls.title: CISA SSDAF exclusion 4 — whether the software is freely obtained and publicly available must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CISA SSDAF exclusion 4 — whether the software is freely obtained and publicly available must be declared true or false

controls.title: CISA SSDAF exclusion 2 — whether the software is open source freely and directly obtained by a Federal agency must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CISA SSDAF exclusion 2 — whether the software is open source freely and directly obtained by a Federal agency must be declared true or false

controls.title: Separating and protecting each environment involved in developing and building software

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Separating and protecting each environment involved in developing and building software

controls.title: Regularly logging, monitoring, and auditing trust relationships used for authorization and access to any software development and build environments

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Regularly logging, monitoring, and auditing trust relationships used for authorization and access to any software development and build environments

controls.title: Regularly logging, monitoring, and auditing trust relationships used for authorization and access among components within each environment

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Regularly logging, monitoring, and auditing trust relationships used for authorization and access among components within each environment

controls.title: Enforcing multi-factor authentication and conditional access across the environments relevant to developing and building software in a manner that minimizes security risk

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Enforcing multi-factor authentication and conditional access across the environments relevant to developing and building software in a manner that minimizes security risk

controls.title: Taking consistent and reasonable steps to document, as well as minimize use or inclusion of software products that create undue risk within the environments used to develop and build software

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Taking consistent and reasonable steps to document, as well as minimize use or inclusion of software products that create undue risk within the environments used to develop and build software

controls.title: Encrypting sensitive data, such as credentials, to the extent practicable and based on risk

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Encrypting sensitive data, such as credentials, to the extent practicable and based on risk

controls.title: Implementing defensive cybersecurity practices, including continuous monitoring of operations and alerts and, as necessary, responding to suspected and confirmed cyber incidents

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implementing defensive cybersecurity practices, including continuous monitoring of operations and alerts and, as necessary, responding to suspected and confirmed cyber incidents

controls.title: The software producer makes a good-faith effort to maintain trusted source code supply chains by employing automated tools or comparable processes to address the security of internal code and third-pa

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer makes a good-faith effort to maintain trusted source code supply chains by employing automated tools or comparable processes to address the security of internal code and third-party components and manage related vulnerabilities

controls.title: The software producer maintains provenance for internal code and third-party components incorporated into the software to the greatest extent feasible

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer maintains provenance for internal code and third-party components incorporated into the software to the greatest extent feasible

controls.title: The software producer employs automated tools or comparable processes that check for security vulnerabilities

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer employs automated tools or comparable processes that check for security vulnerabilities

controls.title: The software producer operates these processes on an ongoing basis and prior to product, version, or update releases

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer operates these processes on an ongoing basis and prior to product, version, or update releases

controls.title: The software producer has a policy or process to address discovered security vulnerabilities prior to product release

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer has a policy or process to address discovered security vulnerabilities prior to product release

controls.title: The software producer operates a vulnerability disclosure program and accepts, reviews, and addresses disclosed software vulnerabilities in a timely fashion and according to any timelines specified in

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer operates a vulnerability disclosure program and accepts, reviews, and addresses disclosed software vulnerabilities in a timely fashion and according to any timelines specified in the vulnerability disclosure program or applicable policies

controls.title: The software producer will notify any agency to which it has submitted this form if and when the producer ceases to make consistent use of the practices identified above in developing the software

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software producer will notify any agency to which it has submitted this form if and when the producer ceases to make consistent use of the practices identified above in developing the software

controls.title: The form is signed by the CEO of the software producer or a designee who is an employee with authority to bind the corporation, OR a FedRAMP-certified or agency-approved 3PAO assessment of conformance

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The form is signed by the CEO of the software producer or a designee who is an employee with authority to bind the corporation, OR a FedRAMP-certified or agency-approved 3PAO assessment of conformance to all elements of the form is attached
